name: Pregabalin Capsules 300mg

specifications.Contraindications: History of amoxicillin-associated cholestatic jaundice or hepatic dysfunction

name: Ivermectin Tablets 10mg (Vet)
storage: Store in a dry place below 30°C.
treatment: Ecto and Endo Parasitic Infections in Livestock & Pets

specifications.Dosing Course: Typically 1 tablet daily for 3 or 5 days
specifications.USP: High compliance due to short course length

specifications.Dosing Advice: Take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects

name: Orlistat Capsules USP 120mg
storage: Store below 25°C. Keep container tightly closed.
description: Orlistat is a reversible gastrointestinal lipase inhibitor that prevents absorption of dietary fats by approximately 30%, aiding weight reduction.

specifications.Mode of Action: Inhibits gastric and pancreatic lipases in the GI tract lumen
specifications.Usage Guideline: Take with each fat-containing main meal (during or up to 1 hr after)

name: Gefitinib Tablets 250mg
description: Geftinat is a targeted oncology kinase inhibitor that blocks the activity of EGFR tyrosine kinase, halting cancer cell replication.

specifications.Warnings: Severe interstitial lung disease risk. Direct monitoring required.
